author: Edge
text:
May be late posting on a topic yesterday but its important and IF mentioned it.

Three stages I went through:

1. Thinking I can jump into the markets and we can all win! based on some shiny indicators and patterns (even news)

2. After a while, I realized that everyone cant win and where liquidity
comes in. Some think this is the aha moment and we can trade with the
ITs who are smart and well backed. I thought how smart, I can trade with
 them. After all, they manipulate to fill orders and make money. Money
can be made with this method but its not for these reasons

3. Finally, I see it for what it is A SCAM!. No such thing as ITs and
Smart money, just the elite few who own nearly every single sovereign
bank in the world aka: Bowers/Rothschilds and all their cronies. Money
is nothing. means %#$# all. Its about taking stops of the everyday
masses and even those so-called "smart investors" to impoverish us all,
but why?. Remember, they create the money. The so-called sovereign banks
 ARE PRIVATELY OWNED by the same group in nearly every country. Its a
disgrace and nobody asks why this is not reported well, because they
control Reuters who also distribute99.9% of news to the world.

If we pressed restart on the whole system, we would owe money on the
very first dollar they printed. Its actually impossible to pay off the
debt. BUT when people and business cant pay back interest on the fake
debt, their very real assets built from fake value are put in the hands
of the elite, so they get tangible assets such as property, physical
buildings, real commodities from nothing in the first place. Pure genius
 and also the very roots of everything wrong in this world.

Just one more thing, order flow does present itself in the charts and
some say as long as I can see this and the manipulation I am fine, as I
can see the clean orders.This is true to some extent, the rule of order
flow will exist. BUT they can always change the way they define entries
and targets. Its a formula they can take the bench mark and add one or
two more variables to throw us off. Say we like well-proved areas such
as qualifiable FLs. Its logical right due to what has been taken out in
the past, the decision to consume orders and make a new FL. , the clean
orders in the new established FL may be a great area for a trade. Its
currently a great way to trade and may be for years to come. BUT even
this logic could always change. If the elite start to work out less and
less people are falling for the traps (dare I say false flags - pun
intended) they may work on a new trick which they have started to do for
 a little while. FLs are still great, but this can change. whose to say
they wont start using a formula based on logic but throwing in a
variable to encrypt it. Its a puzzle almost a code. They are lazy now,
but this may change. Its our job to know how to reverse engineer moves
to find the encryption key.

Sorry for the rant :)
